text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: all 16 tests are OK. I didn't touch the tests. All the fixes were in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`**: the late fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the policy comment and the tests.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` now includes a third book, `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). The tests only fix the title, so I made up the author, year and copy count.
